## Inclusion criterion

<!-- Per CONTRIBUTING.md, every entry must meet at least one. Tick all that apply. -->

- [ ] Category-defining
- [ ] Open source (link to repo with meaningful code)
- [ ] Significant scale ($100M+ funding or widely adopted)
- [ ] Unique technical approach
- [ ] Regional representation (geography/language not yet covered)
- [ ] Academic / research value (peer-reviewed dataset, model, or benchmark)

## Checklist

- [ ] The project has at least 5 GitHub stars (open source), or is a live, publicly accessible product (commercial).
- [ ] The repo is not archived and has a README and a license.
- [ ] This PR adds one entry only and changes no existing lines.
- [ ] Links have no UTM, referral or tracking parameters.
- [ ] Entry is actively maintained (OSS: activity in past 18 months; commercial: live and publicly accessible).
- [ ] Description is neutral and factual — no marketing copy, no superlatives.
- [ ] Formatting matches the surrounding section (em dash separator, region tags where applicable).
- [ ] Not a duplicate of an existing entry.
- [ ] Link-check passes (the CI job will tell you).
